ElmText_Intro:
ELM: !
There you are!

I needed to ask
you a favor.

I'm conducting new
#MON research

right now. I was
wondering if you

could help me with
it, .

You see…

I'm writing a
paper that I want

to present at a
conference.

But there are some
things I don't

quite understand
yet.

So!

I'd like you to
raise a #MON

that I recently
caught.
ElmText_Refused:
But… Please, I
need your help!
ElmText_ResearchAmbitions:
When I announce my
findings, I'm sure

we'll delve a bit
deeper into the

many mysteries of
#MON.

You can count on
it!
ElmText_GotAnEmail:
Oh, hey! I got an
e-mail!


Hm… Uh-huh…

Okay…
ElmText_MissionFromMrPokemon:
Hey, listen.

I have an acquain-
tance called MR. #MON.

He keeps finding
weird things and

raving about his
discoveries.

Anyway, I just got
an e-mail from him

saying that this
time it's real.

It is intriguing,
but we're busy

with our #MON
research…

Wait!

I know!

, can you
go in our place?
ElmText_ChooseAPokemon:
I want you to
raise one of the

#MON contained
in these BALLS.

You'll be that
#MON's first partner, !

Go on. Pick one!
ElmText_LetYourMonBattleIt:
If a wild #MON
appears, let your #MON battle it!
LabWhereGoingText:
ELM: Wait! Where
are you going?
TakeCyndaquilText:
ELM: You'll take
CYNDAQUIL, the fire #MON?
TakeTotodileText:
ELM: Do you want
TOTODILE, the water #MON?
TakeChikoritaText:
ELM: So, you like
CHIKORITA, the grass #MON?
DidntChooseStarterText:
ELM: Think it over
carefully.

Your partner is
important.
ChoseStarterText:
ELM: I think
that's a great #MON too!
ElmDirectionsText1:
MR.#MON lives a
little bit beyond

CHERRYGROVE, the
next city over.

It's almost a
direct route

there, so you
can't miss it.

But just in case,
here's my phone

number. Call me if
anything comes up!
ElmDirectionsText2:
If your #MON is
hurt, you should

heal it with this
machine.

Feel free to use
it anytime.
ElmDescribesMrPokemonText:
MR.#MON goes
everywhere and finds rarities.

Too bad they're
just rare and not very useful…
ElmPokeBallText:
It contains a
#MON caught by PROF.ELM.
ElmsLabHealingMachineText2:
Would you like to
heal your #MON?
ElmAfterTheftText1:
ELM: , this
is terrible…

Oh, yes, what was
MR.#MON's big discovery?
ElmAfterTheftText2:
{PLAYER} handed
the MYSTERY EGG to PROF.ELM.
ElmAfterTheftText4:
But… Is it a
#MON EGG?

If it is, it is a
great discovery!
ElmAfterTheftText5:
ELM: What?!?

PROF.OAK gave you
a #DEX?

, is that
true? Th-that's incredible!

He is superb at
seeing the poten- tial of people as trainers.

Wow, . You
may have what it

takes to become
the CHAMPION.

You seem to be
getting on great with #MON too.

You should take
the #MON GYM challenge.

The closest GYM
would be the one in VIOLET CITY.
ElmAfterTheftText6:
…. The
road to the

championship will
be a long one.

Before you leave,
make sure that you talk to your mom.
ElmStudyingEggText:
ELM: Don't give
up! I'll call if

I learn anything
about that EGG!
ElmAideHasEggText:
ELM: ?
Didn't you meet my assistant?

He should have met
you with the EGG

at VIOLET CITY's
#MON CENTER.

You must have just
missed him. Try to catch him there.
ElmWaitingEggHatchText:
ELM: Hey, has that
EGG changed any?
ElmThoughtEggHatchedText:
? I thought
the EGG hatched.

Where is the
#MON?
ShowElmTogepiText3:
The EGG hatched!
So, #MON are born from EGGS…

No, perhaps not
all #MON are.

Wow, there's still
a lot of research to be done.
ElmGiveEverstoneText1:
Thanks, !
You're helping

unravel #MON
mysteries for us!

I want you to have
this as a token of our appreciation.
ElmGiveEverstoneText2:
That's an
EVERSTONE.

Some species of
#MON evolve

when they grow to
certain levels.

A #MON holding
the EVERSTONE won't evolve.

Give it to a #-
MON you don't want to evolve.
ElmText_CallYou:
ELM: , I'll
call you if any- thing comes up.
AideText_AfterTheft:
…sigh… That
stolen #MON.

I wonder how it's
doing.

They say a #MON
raised by a bad

person turns bad
itself.
ElmGiveMasterBallText1:
ELM: Hi, !
Thanks to you, my

research is going
great!

Take this as a
token of my appreciation.
ElmGiveMasterBallText2:
The MASTER BALL is
the best!

It's the ultimate
BALL! It'll catch

any #MON with-
out fail.

It's given only to
recognized #MON researchers.

I think you can
make much better

use of it than I
can, !
ElmGiveTicketText1:
ELM: !
There you are!

I called because I
have something for you.

See? It's an
S.S.TICKET.

Now you can catch
#MON in KANTO.
ElmGiveTicketText2:
The ship departs
from OLIVINE CITY.

But you knew that
already, .

After all, you've
traveled all over with your #MON.

Give my regards to
PROF.OAK in KANTO!
ElmsLabMonEggText:
It's the #MON
EGG being studied by PROF.ELM.
AideText_GiveYouPotion:
, I want
you to have this for your errand.
AideText_AlwaysBusy:
There are only two
of us, so we're always busy.
AideText_TheftTestimony:
There was a loud
noise outside…

When we went to
look, someone stole a #MON.

It's unbelievable
that anyone would do that!

…sigh… That
stolen #MON.

I wonder how it's
doing.

They say a #MON
raised by a bad

person turns bad
itself.
AideText_ExplainBalls:
To add to your
#DEX, you have to catch #MON.

Throw # BALLS
at wild #MON to get them.
ElmsLabOfficerText1:
I heard a #MON
was stolen here…

I was just getting
some information from PROF.ELM.

Apparently, it was
a young male with long, red hair…

What?

You battled a
trainer like that?

Did you happen to
get his name?
ElmsLabOfficerText2:
OK! So {RIVAL}
was his name.

Thanks for helping
my investigation!
